name: Meia Kreutzerung Hakuhou
original_name: メイア・クロイゼルング・白鳳
source: World renowned genius inventor. She is younger than the protagonist, but because she skipped grades, they are now in the same class. When she speaks she becomes very pushy, and sometimes can be very childish. She has been engaged in research since a very young age, and has never attended school, her enrollment to high school is because she wants to experience a normal school life.
